verdict.rationale: SharePoint documents a REST/OData service and Graph endpoints, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, such as an OData $metadata document. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any candidate path. Describing REST endpoints is not the same as publishing a spec, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
